claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters is on Sunday, April 12.
Early coverage of the 2026 Masters final round includes Featured Groups on Masters.com and the Masters App starting at 9 a.m. ET.
Early coverage of the 2026 Masters final round includes Amen Corner streaming from 11:15 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET.
Featured Groups coverage of the 2026 Masters final round on Sunday, April 12 is from 9:20 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Masters.com and Paramount+.
Amen Corner coverage of the 2026 Masters final round on Sunday, April 12 is from 11:15 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET on Masters.com and Paramount+.
Holes 15 & 16 coverage of the 2026 Masters final round on Sunday, April 12 is from 12:05 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. ET on Masters.com and Paramount+.
Early TV Coverage of the 2026 Masters final round on Sunday, April 12 is from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
Main Broadcast of the 2026 Masters final round on Sunday, April 12 is from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on CBS and Paramount+.
Masters.com provides free, official live streams.
The times are in Eastern Time.
